## What lands

- **`ops/basemap.lock.json` (`sig.basemap-lock/1`)** — the single pin: upstream archive/index bases; the measured reference build `20260930.pmtiles` (138,478,612,042 B, z0–15, schema 4.15.2, 136,127,655 unique tiles — K1 §2.1's live-read numbers, `fetchable: false` since daily builds rotate); the style block (`@protomaps/basemaps` **5.7.2**, BSD-3, the verified v4↔5.x pairing, flavours `light=grayscale` / `dark=black`, `lang: en`, keep/drop/adjust); the glyph block (same-origin `/map/fonts/`, `sig.basemap-glyphs/1` manifest sha256-stamped into the lock, OFL-1.1); the context block (`sig.context-tiles/1` from JUR-01's pack, z0–10, public domain, same-origin — never the tile host); the host block (`cloudflare-r2`, `sig-basemap`, `tiles.surveillancegraph.org`, versioned `basemap/<build>.pmtiles` keys, `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`, CORS `GET,HEAD` + `Range` + `Content-Range/ETag/Content-Length` exposed, `create_status: prepared_not_executed`, preconditions incl. OP-09 + AR-3); `serving.active_source` + the kill-switch text; the refresh steps + 30-day previous-key retention; the cost posture + `release_note.basemap_build` consumer note.
- **`ops/src/ops/basemap.py` + `sig-ops basemap`** — `lock | check | glyphs fetch|verify|stage | context-build | refresh | host | kill-switch`. `check` is the offline posture proof (lock contract incl. the pairing rule; emitted styles bind the lock's key/glyph template/active source; the glyph tree re-hashes against its manifest; CSP `connect-src` admits the tile origin — resolved through `BASEMAP_TILE_ORIGIN`; the alert schema + kill-switch declaration exist). `glyphs fetch` walks the pinned upstream (`protomaps.github.io/basemaps-assets`, `raw.githubusercontent.com` mirror first — the Pages CDN 503s under bulk fetch; retries w/ backoff), sha256-manifests every range + `OFL.txt`, stages under `web/public/map/fonts/`, `--stamp-lock` writes the manifest root. `context-build` verifies the boundary pack (fail-closed `verify_pack`) then renders `sig.context-tiles/1` PMTiles (boundary outlines + place-name points, z0–10). `refresh --apply` is the real leg — resolve `builds.json` (schema-major check refuses non-v4), stream-download hashing **blake3** against the index's `b3sum` (partial file unlinked on any mismatch), upload under the new versioned key with the immutable `Cache-Control`, record `host.served` + previous-key retirement — env-gated by `apply_gate` (exit 42 + the verbatim re-run prompt on any unmet precondition; AR-3 windows enforced). `host --apply` drives three Cloudflare API calls (bucket create → CORS → custom domain) behind the same gate. `kill-switch` flips `serving.active_source → context` — the K1 §2.4 "points the style at the boundaries fallback" — so every generated document repoints on the next build.
- **Generated styles** — `web/scripts/gen-map-styles.mjs` reads the lock and emits `web/public/map/style-light.json`, `style-dark.json`, `style-context.json` (committed; `--verify` runs inside `npm run check`). K1 §2.5 verbatim: drops `address_label`, `roads_shields`, `roads_oneway` (POI-class + the only sprite-requiring layers), strips every `icon-image` reference (**no sprite sheet is served**), `buildings` ≥ z15, `roads_labels_major` ≥ z13, `lang: "en"`; each document carries `sig:basemap` metadata (active_source, served_key, host_status) so `sig-ops basemap check` binds them to the lock.
- **`web/src/lib/basemap.ts`** — the TS contract mirror: `BASEMAP_TILE_ORIGIN`, `GLYPH_URL_TEMPLATE`, the verbatim K1 §2.3 attribution strings, `assertBasemapStyleContract` (pmtiles sources only; `basemap` → the tile origin, `context` → same-origin; attribution on every source; no sprite; glyphs same-origin; dropped ids refused).
- **`web/astro.config.mjs`** — `connect-src 'self' https://tiles.surveillancegraph.org` via the `BASEMAP_TILE_ORIGIN` constant (K0 §4.8's literal `<SIG tile origin>` row inside ADR-223's split; T0 pages drop the directive anyway).

- **`docs/build/reports/p36.33-basemap-host/`** — `PACKET.md` + `packet.json` (`sig.basemap-host-packet/1`): verbatim GATE-G5 naming, preconditions, the exact re-run prompt, the header-verify checklist, restore point.
